title: Mercury Marauder Engines by Year
description: Every factory engine in the Mercury Marauder by year: the 390 and 427 FE V8s of 1963–65, the 390 and 429 of 1969–70, and the 4.6 DOHC V8 of the 2003–04 sedan.
intro: Mercury used the Marauder name three times: for its fastback-roof full-size cars from mid-1963 to 1965, for a big two-door hardtop in 1969 and 1970, and for a high-performance sedan in 2003 and 2004. In between, Marauder named Mercury engines rather than a car.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The 390 FE in several outputs and the 427 FE with one or two four-barrels.
The 390 and the 429 385-series V8; the X-100 came only with the 429 four-barrel.
The 4.6 DOHC Modular V8, the only engine.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
